description.en: Rodeo Legend smashes a plant and launches his zombie rider past most of your defenses.
description.zh: 骑牛竞技传奇击溃一株植物，并将身上的牛骑手投出越过你的大部分防线。

chat.en: "Legend" perhaps overstates Rodeo Legend's status in the rodeo world. Don't tell him that, though, unless you're desperate to hear an hour-long tirade about calf-roping.
chat.zh: “传奇”这个词，在骑牛竞赛界用来形容骑牛竞技传奇或许过于夸张。别让他听到了，不然你会绝望地听他那长达一小时关于犊牛的演讲。

text.en: smashes the first plant he meets while rushing
text.zh: 冲刺时撞死遇到的第一株植物

text.en: launches a low flying imp rider over plants
text.zh: 低空丢出一只小鬼，越过植物
高坚果能挡住飞出的小鬼
